we have adapted MTGO, a gene network module identification method, for the single-cell transcriptomic data analysis and have integrated MTGO-SC in the Seurat sc RNA-seq pipeline, making it available to the community.
we present MTGO-SC (MTGO for single-cell), a novel algorithm that can be used to identify biological modules in scRNA-seq data.
MTGO-SC identifies biological modules in single-cell RNA sequencing data, leveraging on the network topology and on external gene annotations.

developing and validating new methods for the analysis of scRNA-seq data.
the development of computational methods for the analysis of biological networks.

we have developed a new algorithm for the detection of biological modules from scRNA-seq data, MTGO-SC.

the MTGO-SC algorithm allows for the detection of functional modules from single-cell data.
